title: cli: broken symlinks in source directory are silently ignored

# Bug: Broken Symlinks Silently Ignored

## Severity
P2 - MINOR

## Description
When the source directory contains broken symlinks, the index command silently ignores them with no warning. This could mask configuration issues where users expect certain files to be indexed.

## Reproduction Steps
1. mkdir /tmp/broken-test
2. ln -s /nonexistent/file /tmp/broken-test/broken-link
3. ./doc_transformer index /tmp/broken-test --output /tmp/out
4. Returns "Found 0 files" with no indication that broken symlinks existed

## Expected Behavior
Either:
- Skip broken symlinks with a warning message
- Or fail with an error if --strict is specified

## Fix Required
Add warning when broken symlinks are encountered in source.
